settings.tool: Adobe Firefly, Generate video, with First frame + Last frame (same model as clip c01)
settings.relevance: Leave camera-motion presets off: the prompt describes the move

blocks.style: Photorealistic architectural visualization film of a luxury modern Kerala-style Indian home, like a premium real-estate launch film. Real-world materials and scale, natural light, physically accurate shadows and reflections, crisp detail, cinematic colour grade, soft evening haze. One continuous, slow, perfectly smooth stabilized camera move (gimbal or drone). No cuts.
blocks.house: The house (identical in every shot, as in clip c01): a two-storey Kerala-style villa with warm cream plaster walls, terracotta clay-tile gable roofs, stone-clad piers and wall panels, a first-floor balcony with a black metal railing and vertical timber louvres, teak-framed windows glowing warmly, a deep entrance porch with white columns on dark granite bases, a coffered teak ceiling with downlights and a brass hanging lantern, a carved teak front door between slatted timber side panels, dark granite steps with small step lights, a cream compound wall with stone-clad gate pillars and a sliding wooden-slat gate, coconut palms and lush tropical planting.
blocks.interior: The interior (the same home as the start image): cream lime-plaster walls, dark grey polished stone floors, teak and cane furniture, wooden lattice jali screens, brass dome pendant lamps, terracotta and copper pots on open wooden shelves, jute rugs, potted plants, white-framed windows with soft natural daylight and lush greenery outside.
blocks.negative: cartoon, CGI game graphics, low-poly, 3D toy model, clay render, illustration, painting, anime, oversaturated, plastic-looking materials, warped or bending walls, morphing architecture, melting objects, flickering lights, house design changing, people, animals, moving cars, text, captions, logos, watermark, fisheye distortion, shaky handheld camera, fast motion, cuts, scene change

clips.title: Arrival: street to front porch
clips.purpose: Opening shot. Reveals the whole house at sunset, then carries the visitor from the street to the front door.
clips.camera: Slow dolly forward plus a gentle crane down to eye level, ending square-on to the front door
clips.reference: Reference video 0–2 s: wide establishing view of the building, then a steady push toward the entrance
clips.prompt: Slow, steady dolly forward from the street toward the house at sunset. The black lattice front gate swings open as the camera approaches; the camera passes through it, travels up the paved driveway and gently lowers to eye level, ending centred in front of the entrance porch: square cream columns, warm downlights in the teak ceiling, the carved teak double front door, potted plants and a lit brass diya beside the stone steps. Palm fronds sway gently in the breeze.

clips.title: Through the front door into the living room
clips.purpose: The first move from outside to inside; it must feel like walking in through the door.
clips.camera: Push-in up the steps and through the doorway (the door opens as the camera approaches)
clips.reference: Reference video 2–3.5 s: push through the glass entrance doors into the lobby
clips.prompt: The camera moves slowly forward up the dark granite steps with their small step lights, under the brass hanging lantern, toward the carved teak front door. The door swings open inward and the camera glides through the doorway into a warm, spacious living room: cream sofas with cushions, a low wooden coffee table on a soft rug, a dark-wood ceiling fan, a teak-panelled TV wall with a low console, cove lighting in a stepped ceiling and tall windows with sheer curtains.

clips.title: Living room to dining area
clips.purpose: Shows the open plan: living flows into dining.
clips.camera: Slow lateral track to the right with a slight pan
clips.reference: Reference video 3.7–4.5 s: slow drift across the lobby
clips.prompt: Slow lateral tracking shot to the right through the living room, past a tall carved wooden jali screen, revealing the dining area: a solid wood dining table with wooden chairs, a cluster of brass pendant lamps, a carved wooden wall panel, a teak sideboard and large potted plants.

clips.title: Dining area to kitchen
clips.purpose: Continues the ground-floor tour into the kitchen.
clips.camera: Smooth push forward through a wide opening
clips.reference: Reference video 3.7–4.5 s: continuous drift through connected spaces
clips.prompt: The camera glides forward past the dining table and through a wide opening into the kitchen: teak-wood cabinets, dark stone countertops with warm under-cabinet lighting, a built-in oven, a chimney hood, and a window over the sink looking out to green trees.

clips.title: Kitchen, up the stairs, into the master bedroom
clips.purpose: Moves from the ground floor to the first floor without a cut.
clips.camera: Pan away from the kitchen, then a smooth rise up the staircase and a push into the bedroom
clips.reference: Reference video 4.5–6 s: the camera rises floor by floor
clips.risk: The staircase isn't in any storyboard panel, so the AI has to invent it. Generate 3–4 takes. If none convinces, change the first sentence to: 'The camera turns away from the kitchen and drifts slowly forward as the view softly dissolves into the master bedroom.'
clips.prompt: The camera turns away from the kitchen, rises smoothly up a teak staircase with a wooden handrail to the first floor and enters the master bedroom: a large bed with cream linen and cushions in front of a vertical teak headboard wall, bedside tables with glowing lamps, a soft patterned rug, sheer curtains and sliding glass doors to a balcony.

clips.title: Master bedroom to en-suite bathroom
clips.purpose: Shows the attached bathroom and its finishes.
clips.camera: Slow pan left, then glide forward through a doorway
clips.reference: Reference video 6–7 s: looking into the residence
clips.prompt: Slow pan to the left and glide forward through a doorway into the en-suite bathroom: warm natural stone walls and floor, a backlit mirror, a floating wooden vanity with a white vessel basin, a frameless glass walk-in shower with a rain shower head, a small window and a potted plant.

clips.title: Bathroom, through the bedroom, out to the terrace
clips.purpose: Leaves the interior and opens up to the sky: the emotional high point.
clips.camera: Turn back, glide across the bedroom and out through the sliding doors
clips.reference: Reference video 7–9 s: drift toward the glazing and out to the rooftop
clips.prompt: The camera turns back out of the bathroom, crosses the bedroom and passes through open sliding glass doors onto the covered terrace at sunset: a teak pergola ceiling, cushioned outdoor sofas, a wooden coffee table with a lit brass diya, potted palms, a cream parapet, and a wide view over coconut palms to a glowing orange and blue sky.

clips.title: Terrace down to the side garden
clips.purpose: Shows the landscaping around the house.
clips.camera: Float forward over the parapet, then a slow crane down beside the house
clips.reference: Reference video 8.5–9.3 s: from the rooftop back out to the building
clips.risk: Storyboard panel 9 shows a different-looking house. Use the regenerated keyframe 09 (see 00-keyframes/fixes/FIXES.md) or the house will morph.
clips.prompt: The camera floats forward over the terrace parapet and descends smoothly along the side of the house to the garden: a manicured green lawn, young trees, low warm garden lights along a cream compound wall, and the house's terracotta-tile eaves, balconies and warm windows on the right, under a dusk sky.

clips.title: Garden rising to the aerial view
clips.purpose: Drone reveal of the whole plot: roofs, gardens, drive and road.
clips.camera: Drone: vertical rise past the roofline, then tilt down to a high three-quarter top view
clips.reference: Reference video 9.3–9.6 s: pull back to reveal the whole building
clips.risk: Storyboard panels 9 and 10 both differ from the main house. Use both regenerated keyframes (00-keyframes/fixes/FIXES.md).
clips.prompt: Drone shot: the camera rises vertically from the garden, past the eaves and above the terracotta tiled roofs, then tilts down to look over the whole plot: the hipped tile roofs and front gable, balconies, lawns, the cream compound wall, the paved driveway and the road, surrounded by dense green trees. Warm lights are just coming on.

clips.title: Aerial descending to the front at night
clips.purpose: Brings the camera back to the front of the house as night falls.
clips.camera: Drone descends and arcs round to the front elevation; the light changes from dusk to night
clips.reference: Reference video 9.6–10 s: the building against the night skyline
clips.prompt: The drone descends slowly and arcs around to the front of the house as dusk turns to deep blue night. The windows, facade lights, gate lanterns and garden lights grow brighter and warmer. The shot ends on the front elevation at night, seen from the street, with the black lattice gate and lit pillars in the foreground.

clips.title: Closing: night pull-back
clips.purpose: Final calm shot; the website fades in the SAN Construction card over it.
clips.reference: Reference video 10–14 s: hold on the lit building while the end card fades in
clips.prompt: Very slow, steady pull-back from the front of the house at night. The house glows warmly from within, the gate lanterns and uplights are lit, and the palm leaves move slightly in the breeze. Calm and still, no new elements.
